verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance embeds generative and agentic AI across the product, including the Insights Agent which 'delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics,' plus AI-generated Post-Incident Reviews, Intelligent Alert Grouping via ML, and AI Orchestrations that 'automatically analyze historical events and incidents and surface recommended rules.' These are first-party documented, in-product AI insight/suggestion features, not just chat add-ons. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration of these specific AI insight features (community evidence pack predates these AI features and doesn't address them), and more detail on accuracy/quality of the generated insights.
